positions.title: Managing Director, Tech Lead & Senior Staff Engineer
IT Manager/Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Planned and implemented an upgrade to a Google Apps architecture, in place of an archaic previous system.
- Designed and implemented a cost-effective on-site and off-site backup solution for sensitive data.
- Continually resolved minor and major problems, both hardware and software related.

positions.title: IT Manager/Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented Windows Server, Active Directory, File and Print Sharing, and Advanced Routing for an expansive network across 75 acres composed of four subnets.
- Managed and educated High School IT interns each with no previous IT experience.
- Continually oversaw upgrades of software and hardware on-site and at a satellite office in Chicago.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Worked directly with the senior IT staff, accomplishing tasks as simple as fixing printers and as complex as handling network issues during AD implementation.
